config.name: Signals accepted by the collector
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, MetricName AS signal, sum(Value) AS accepted FROM default.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName IN ('otelcol_receiver_accepted_spans', 'otelcol_receiver_accepted_log_records', 'otelcol_receiver_accepted_metric_points') GROUP BY ts, signal ORDER BY ts

config.name: Signals refused or failed
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, MetricName AS signal, sum(Value) AS failed FROM default.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName IN ('otelcol_receiver_refused_spans', 'otelcol_receiver_failed_spans', 'otelcol_receiver_refused_log_records', 'otelcol_receiver_failed_log_records', 'otelcol_receiver_refused_metric_points', 'otelcol_receiver_failed_metric_points') GROUP BY ts, signal ORDER BY ts

config.name: Signals written to ClickHouse
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, MetricName AS signal, sum(Value) AS exported FROM default.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName IN ('otelcol_exporter_sent_spans', 'otelcol_exporter_sent_log_records', 'otelcol_exporter_sent_metric_points') GROUP BY ts, signal ORDER BY ts

config.name: Exporter queue depth vs capacity
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, MetricName AS gauge, max(Value) AS value FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName IN ('otelcol_exporter_queue_size', 'otelcol_exporter_queue_capacity', 'otelcol_exporter_in_flight_requests') GROUP BY ts, gauge ORDER BY ts

config.name: Collector memory (RSS)
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, round(max(Value) / 1024 / 1024, 1) AS rss_mb FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName = 'otelcol_process_memory_rss' GROUP BY ts ORDER BY ts

config.name: Batch trigger mix
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, MetricName AS trigger, sum(Value) AS batches FROM default.otel_metrics_sum WHERE MetricName IN ('otelcol_processor_batch_batch_size_trigger_send', 'otelcol_processor_batch_timeout_trigger_send') GROUP BY ts, trigger ORDER BY ts

config.name: Prometheus scrape health
config.sqlTemplate: SELECT $__timeInterval(TimeUnix) AS ts, MetricName AS metric, round(avg(Value), 3) AS value FROM default.otel_metrics_gauge WHERE MetricName IN ('up', 'scrape_duration_seconds') GROUP BY ts, metric ORDER BY ts
